reddit.title: Enhancing the Audio Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat music beds now feature a seamless transition instead of abrupt cuts. This means a smoother listening experience while you build your colony. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
